azure.review.application_insights.select.description: Selected Application Insights trace samples have no detected secrets. Inspect only explicitly selected supported message samples with both offline detectors.
azure.review.application_insights.select.fail_observation: A likely secret was detected in the selected message sample. Its value is hidden and was not validated.
azure.review.application_insights.select.missing_observation: The selected message sample was unavailable, empty, unbound or incompletely inspected. A clean sample result cannot be established.
azure.review.application_insights.select.pass_observation: Both offline detectors completed without detecting a supported secret in the selected message sample. This result covers only the returned sample from the fixed preceding hour.
azure.review.application_insights.select.purpose: Explicit selected application message samples from a fixed preceding hour only, at most100 rows total. No whole-history, ingestion, runtime, protected-store or credential-validation claim.
azure.review.application_insights.select.remediation: Remove credential literals from application logging, rotate confirmed exposed credentials and review retained copies. Use managed identities or supported secret references.
azure.review.application_insights.select.title: Selected Application Insights trace samples have no detected secrets
